kind: counterfeiters' cache (tools and bars of metal plowed up)
summary: Biography of Mr. Biles: while farming in Pepin Twp from 1848 he 'turned up with his plow tools and bars of metal which had probably been used by a gang of counterfeiters who operated in this section at an early day; hence the name of this stream, Bogus Creek.' No farm owner or section given.
